body: ADVISOR RULING (02:20): ALLOW the immutable guard dir first. Oracle PATH = <frozen guard dir>:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin. The fixed-PATH rule excludes trial-WRITABLE entries; the guard dir is aida-owned, content-addressed, hash-verified before every run and bound read-only, so it's inside the trust boundary. Conditions: (1) no prefix or trial entry anywhere on the oracle PATH; (2) each guard logs to the inherited trusted fd, then execs the real tool by ABSOLUTE host path resolved by aida at freeze time (never a PATH re-lookup, so no recursion and no shadowing); (3) the guard set is generated from required_tools only; (4) test: a bare required-tool call from the oracle emits a guard event, and clean reflects it.
subject: RULING: #2660 guard dir first on oracle PATH
